text: handler carrying J's decision (7 Oct 2026, 20:27 Amsterdam), J's words: 'Go on both'. 1: before going on down the order, review the three largest kinds for the kinds inside them, T3-010 making deals with neighbouring rooms, T3-009 celebrating the finished work and T3-014 moving the planning into a Discord: read every member's second-order theme and its concepts; split where members do different organizing work (logged as a split, a new kind for the rule, J 2026-09-29) and move the members; keep and log why where they do the same work. 2: then reread whole the 52 rooms of B1b-03 and B1b-04 (order 42 NewMexico to 93 chile), revising placements and minting where concepts show a kind the scheme lacks; such kinds count where I stand in the order. Start at the next safe stop; not a stretch; its own diary lines; the close line says how much of each part is done; if the close check objects to a leg with no stretch, log it and ask.
